decisions.reason: As a newly launched product that was still mentioned in 2023, it likely remains below a firm kill threshold despite somewhat weaker visible commitment, so boundedly rational management would keep it for another year while monitoring whether it reaches aspiration levels.

Its own product page in 2023 signals a meaningful launch commitment, and with limited post-launch evidence an established German food manufacturer would usually use available slack to continue learning before reallocating resources.

A premium salami sharing snack with its own page appears to have received clear market support at launch, so unless results clearly fell short of aspirations management would be inclined to keep it on the market for further evaluation.
